name: io.github.SupplyMaven-SCR/supply-chain-intelligence
title: SupplyMaven Supply Chain Intelligence
description: Real-time supply chain risk intelligence — 34 tools, proprietary indices, predictive signals

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your SupplyMaven API key (get a free key at supplymaven.com/developers)

tools.name: supply_chain_risk_assessment
tools.description: Global Disruption Index (GDI) — real-time 0-100 composite score measuring supply chain disruption risk across Transportation, Energy, Materials, and Macro pillars. Built from 200+ live data variables, updated every 15 minutes.

tools.name: commodity_price_monitor
tools.description: Real-time prices for 31 commodities across energy, metals, agriculture, industrial, and semiconductor materials. Includes 24-hour change percentage and price history.

tools.name: supply_chain_disruption_alerts
tools.description: Real-time disruption alerts from global news intelligence — port closures, tariff changes, sanctions, natural disasters, labor strikes, and weather disruptions.

tools.name: manufacturing_output_indicator
tools.description: Patent-pending Supply Manufacturing Index (SMI) — detects US manufacturing output changes up to 24 hours before official government reports by analyzing weather-normalized electricity demand across 8 US power grid regions. INVERTED scale: lower = stronger.

tools.name: risk_pillar_breakdown
tools.description: Detailed breakdown of GDI by risk category — individual scores for Transportation (30%), Energy (25%), Materials (25%), and Macro (20%) pillars with weights, policy adjustments, and news boost values.

tools.name: port_congestion_monitor
tools.description: Real-time port congestion and vessel traffic at 26 major global ports. Vessel counts, congestion scores versus historical baselines, and port status across US, Asian, and European ports.

tools.name: get_action_signals
tools.description: Statistically validated leading indicator signals evaluated against live GDI and SMI data. Each signal is a Granger-causal relationship (p<=0.01) with directional accuracy >=55%. Returns ACTIVE, WATCH, or CLEAR status with lag times.

tools.name: get_border_delays
tools.description: Real-time commercial border crossing wait times at 80+ US-Mexico and US-Canada ports of entry. Updated every 30 minutes from US Customs and Border Protection. Filter by border or specific crossing.

tools.name: get_chokepoint_traffic
tools.description: Real-time vessel traffic at critical maritime chokepoints — Suez Canal, Panama Canal, Strait of Malacca, Strait of Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, and other strategic waterways. Congestion scores and vessel counts.

tools.name: get_air_cargo_disruptions
tools.description: Air cargo disruption status at 39 US and international freight hub airports. FAA ground delays, ground stops, disruption scores, and traffic collapse detection from FlightAware data.

tools.name: get_trade_policy_impacts
tools.description: Active trade policy actions impacting supply chain risk — tariffs, sanctions, export controls, import restrictions. Policies persist and continue to modify GDI risk scores, unlike transient news alerts.

tools.name: get_energy_breakdown
tools.description: Comprehensive US energy market data — crude oil prices, natural gas spot (Henry Hub), retail fuel prices, natural gas storage, refinery utilization, petroleum stocks, and import/export trade flows.

tools.name: get_rail_freight_status
tools.description: US freight rail performance metrics — train speed, terminal dwell time, cars on line, carloadings, intermodal units, and grain transport rates from STB, AAR, and USDA sources.

tools.name: get_freight_transportation_index
tools.description: BTS Transportation Services Index for freight, truck tonnage, rail carloadings, rail intermodal, waterborne freight, and inventory-to-sales ratio for supply chain flow analysis.

tools.name: get_economic_indicators
tools.description: Federal Reserve economic data (industrial production, capacity utilization, manufacturing), Producer Price Index, NY Fed Global Supply Chain Pressure Index, and EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook forecasts.

tools.name: get_predictive_signals
tools.description: 58 validated Granger-causal signals predicting supply chain outcomes 1 week to 6 months ahead. ACTIVE/WATCH/CLEAR status with statistical confidence, lag times, and directional accuracy. Filter by tier, status, or predictor.

tools.name: get_signal_narratives
tools.description: Plain-language explanations of signal mechanisms and economic logic for each of 58 predictive signals. Suitable for executive briefings, client reports, and AI agent reasoning chains.

tools.name: get_manufacturing_anomalies
tools.description: Electricity demand anomaly detection across 8 US grid regions for early manufacturing shift warnings. Patent-pending weather normalization isolates industrial demand from commercial and residential.

tools.name: get_energy_forecast
tools.description: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook forward-looking projections — crude oil production, natural gas prices, electricity generation, renewable capacity. Actual vs forecast comparison across 1,467 tracked series.

tools.name: get_gdi_trend_analysis
tools.description: GDI risk trend direction, velocity, acceleration, and pillar-level momentum over 7/14/30/90-day windows. Detects regime changes and trend reversals before they show in the headline number.

tools.name: get_commodity_volatility_alerts
tools.description: Abnormal commodity price movement detection across 31 commodities. Flags unusual 24-hour changes that may signal supply disruptions, demand shifts, or speculative activity.

tools.name: get_port_congestion_trends
tools.description: Port congestion trajectory and acceleration versus historical baselines at 26 global ports. Trend direction and velocity — because direction of change matters more than point-in-time score.

tools.name: get_intelligence_briefs
tools.description: AI-generated hourly analytical briefs per supply chain dimension — energy, materials, transportation, macro, and manufacturing. Cross-pillar awareness with anti-hallucination safeguards.

tools.name: get_natural_disaster_alerts
tools.description: Real-time natural disaster alerts from USGS (earthquakes M5.0+), NOAA (storms/hurricanes), and GDACS (global earthquakes, cyclones, floods, volcanoes). Returns active events with magnitude, severity, coordinates, and affected country.

tools.name: get_corridor_risk
tools.description: Risk levels across 10 major ocean freight trade corridors (China-US, Taiwan-US, India-US, China-Europe, Europe-US, Middle East-Europe, Brazil-US). Weakest-link scoring chains ports and chokepoints into end-to-end lane risk. Includes natural disaster proximity boost.

tools.name: get_supply_chain_weekly_brief
tools.description: Comprehensive weekly intelligence report — GDI pillar scores, manufacturing output, port congestion, active predictive signals, top disruption events, commodity movements, and key takeaways in a single call.

tools.name: get_weekly_content_package
tools.description: Weekly 'Signal of the Week' content package — pre-written, data-verified marketing bundle with Substack article, LinkedIn post, and Twitter thread. Every number traces back to a live data source.

tools.name: get_freight_rate_observations
tools.description: Freight rate index observations from news intelligence. Covers BDI, SCFI, WCI, CCFI, HARPEX with direction, magnitude, trade lane, and rate values. Each observation includes confidence score and source URL.

tools.name: get_customs_trade_events
tools.description: Customs and trade policy events from news intelligence. Tariff changes, sanctions, export controls, trade agreements. Includes affected countries, products, direction (RESTRICTIVE/LIBERALIZING), and US impact assessment.

tools.name: get_labor_actions
tools.description: Labor actions affecting supply chains — strikes, lockouts, slowdowns, contract negotiations. Includes union, employer, location, worker count, affected ports, and status.

tools.name: get_freight_rate_pressure
tools.description: Freight rate pressure scores for WCI and SCFI container indices. Z-score vs 52-week baseline mapped to 0-100. Levels: STABLE, ELEVATED, VOLATILE, SURGING, EXTREME. Includes corridor mapping.

tools.name: get_customs_friction_baseline
tools.description: Per-country customs friction baseline (0-100) combining port congestion (55%) and trade policy events (45%). 21 countries across 7 regions. Higher = more friction.

tools.name: get_disaster_events
tools.description: Active natural disaster events from USGS, NOAA, and GDACS with geographic and type filtering. Complements get_natural_disaster_alerts with region-based filtering and multi-day lookback.

tools.name: get_port_disruption_index
tools.description: Port Readiness scores measuring land-side logistics at 7 major US ports. 5-component composite (0-100): rail terminal dwell, vessel congestion, highway incidents, truck availability, and weather. Nodes: LA/LB, NY/NJ, Savannah, Houston, Seattle/Tacoma, El Paso, Laredo.
